title: redesign_slide
description: Make a slide again in another form, keeping its title, its text and its notes: the idea the person chose from ask_artist (idea), or what they ask for (wish, the Artist proposes it). Reviewed by the person as any change.

slide_id.description: The slide: its number in the deck (1 = first) or its ID.

idea.description: The number of the idea ask_artist gave for this slide.

wish.description: Instead of an idea: what the person asks for ("as a diagram", "two columns").
